mapper.sql: select warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, manager_name, contact_phone, province, city, county, address, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from erp_warehouse
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by warehouse_code asc
mapper.insert: insert into erp_warehouse(warehouse_code, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, manager_name, contact_phone, province, city, county, address, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{warehouseType}, #{managerName}, #{contactPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{county}, #{address}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
